definitions.short: a circumstance (as rolled around); only used adverbially, on account of
definitions.full: H1558. galal I. [ גָּלָל ] noun [masculine] account , only in construct stative with בִּגְלַל בְּ, on account of, for the sake of ( a great and momentous matter ; on thy account ; compare דְּ בִּגְלַל מִן because that in Palestinian ᵑ7 , as Psalm 4:9, and in Jerusalem Syriac PS 731 ) Gen 39:5 ׳י blessed the house of the Egyptian יוֺסֵף בִּגְלַל on account of Joseph, Deut 15:10 ; 18:12 ; 1Kin 14:16 ; Jer 11:17 ; 15:4 ; with suffix בִּגְלָלֶ֑ךָ Gen 30:27 ; בִּגְלָלֵךְ 12:13 ; בִּגְלַלְכֶם Deut 1:37 ; Micah 3:12 .
